verses.text: It was the time of the wheat harvest. The Lord sent death upon Israel from morning until the time of the morning meal; the devastation began among the people, and seventy thousand men of the people died from Dan to Beersheba.

verses.text: God’s angel stretched his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, but the Lord relented concerning the calamity and said to the angel destroying the people, “Enough! Now withdraw your hand.” The Lord’s angel was beside the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite.

verses.text: When David saw the angel striking the people, he spoke to the Lord and said, “Behold, I myself have done wrong; I, the shepherd, have done evil. But these sheep—what have they done? Please let Thy hand be against me and my father’s house.”
